# polaris_catalog_role (Resource)

Manage a Polaris catalogRole. Objects are never silently adopted; import existing names before applying.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_catalog_role" "reader" {
  catalog = "warehouse"
  name    = "iam_analysts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Existing catalog containing this role.
- `name` (String) Stable Polaris object name.

### Optional

- `properties` (Map of String) String properties owned by this resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import polaris_catalog_role.reader '["warehouse","iam_analysts"]'
```
